The '''TC-SC infiltration droid''' was an [[espionage droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and designed for obtaining intelligence from areas too difficult to breach by less-advanced espionage [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TC-SC_infiltration_droid_FC.png|thumb|left|250px|A TC-SC assumes the appearance of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].]]
The TC-SC model gained its advantage through the maxim of "nobody takes notice of a droid doing its job." The TC-SC [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was designed to resemble a [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]] and was therefore inconspicuous when moving around offices, government buildings, or other public spaces. Its spindly limbs, oversized head, and featureless faceplate encouraged the deception. Programmable for a variety of genders and often quiet and conciliatory, its two, [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] were equally innocuous.<ref name="EV" />

Beneath the docile surface, the TC-SC were programmed for intelligence and counterintelligence, stealth, infiltration, combat, [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], and acting. Equipped with a [[CQ-3.80 multispectrum disguise suite|multispectrum disguise suite]], the TC-SC was capable of assuming the appearance of any [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] droid or being, and could even mimic certain individuals. The programming systems of these droids was relatively delicate, requiring constant maintenance and frequent [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipes]] to prevent them from becoming delusional but otherwise, their systems were so advanced that they were virtually impossible to detect via sensor or scanner alone. Some droids were known to malfunction and start to believe that they were actually who they were impersonating.<ref name="EV" />

==History==
Designed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] for intelligence gathering
TC-SC droids were occasionally used by leaders and other dignitaries as decoys in order to protect against assassination attempts. After a public appearance or speech, an official would trade places with an identical TC-SC droid. This would allow the official to be surreptitiously secreted away, leaving the droid to deal with any possible threats, and in the worst case, spontaneously self destruct to cover a daring getaway.<ref name="EV" />

While the implications of their design were frightening to some, the droid was relatively rare due to restrictions put in place by the galactic government. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign, two TC-SCs in the service of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] went rogue, deserting their assignments in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and operating on their own agendas.<ref name="EV" />
